notes: Same series as animation2 (same Netflix cyberpunk anime: Thai Netflix dubbing credits at the end; verified by comparing frames from animation2.mp4). Reused labels: smoking_man (the dark-haired man with white jaw plates and gold chin piece; animation2 frame 490 shows him smoking, here he is the most frequent face: cards 0,6,7,12,13), goggles_young_man (the stitched-scalp kid with rectangular glasses, fangs, green shirt: cards 1,8; he matches animation2's greyscale goggles man exactly, so he is not an adult), old_cyborg (blond stitched cyborg with goatee and teal-lined coat, now with an eyepatch over one red lens: card 9), red_marked_boy (card 2), pink_haired_girl (card 4; her early tracks 3:23-6:14 are in dim blue light where her hair looks silver), blond_boy (unassigned runs). New characters: orange_eyed_boy = boy with pinkish-brown hair, orange eyes, a green collar and a hair clip (card 3, 8:43-10:31, in a chat screen with names Kyoko/Roman); green_haired_girl = girl with shaggy dark-green hair, blue eyes, magenta face markings (card 11, 25:10-25:35; also U10/U11 in a cap at 5:30, U40, C10T7); dark_suited_man = short dark-haired man in a dark suit, background of a dim lab scene at 5:52-6:00 (C5T2, box x~653); grey_haired_man = man with slicked-back grey hair in profile in the same scene (C5T1, box x~699), and U4 (2:51, grey-haired older man in profile) given the same label with low confidence; news_anchor = blond woman on a TV news screen (C10T1, 5:27); police_officer = man in a police cap (U12, 5:42). Uncertain: card 5 is mixed; dark_suited_man is only a plurality (16 of 48), grey_haired_man 13, and both are small background faces. Card 10 is mixed; majority is washed-out pink end-credits art (C10T8-T21, unknown, as in animation2). C5T0/C5T4 and U7/U8 are armoured soldiers in helmets/visors (left unknown). U13-U17 (5:43-5:47) are blond_boy seen from behind/three-quarter with his backpack, labelled from hair, as in animation2. U21-U25 (14:15-14:20) are faces in memory photos overlaid on a red genome-analysis screen (a red/pink-haired child, a grinning blond man); possibly young pink_haired_girl / old_cyborg but left unknown. U34 and U41 switch person part-way with a tie (blond_boy then green_haired_girl); labelled blond_boy. U30 (19:47) and C10T5 (19:02) are graphic mask/face drawings, labelled not-a-face. U9, U19, U32 are hands. C1T11 ends with 5 smoking_man faces (10:41-10:43) after 15 of the kid; C0T14's last face partly overlapped by pink hair. C13T0/T2 are smoking_man with his face turned away (hair and gold chin piece visible). Checked: 317.567 the glasses kid (goggles_young_man) is small but recognisable and unboxed (smoking_man beside him is turned away, not counted); 1269.018 pink_haired_girl clearly visible, unboxed; 1110.526 pink girl only seen from behind (not counted); 1427.509 figures too tiny. Renamed when matching names across the series (same face, different names): green_haired_girl -> green_haired_cap_girl.
